errors.text_span: The chart illustrates measured “effect” values across language families, with multiple model variants shown as grouped bars for each family. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variable “family,” ordered left to right as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 10, 20, and 30 (values extending slightly above 30), and each bar includes vertical error bars indicating uncertainty.
